sign_up_subtitle: Start planning in a few minutes.
google_unavailable: Google sign-in is not configured on this environment.
google_popup_blocked: Your browser blocked the Google sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
username_help: Letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen. No @ sign.
password_help: At least 8 characters. Use something you don't use elsewhere.
sign_up_pending_body: If that address can be used, we've sent a link to confirm it. The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
forgot_password_body: Enter the email address on your account and we'll send a reset link.
forgot_password_sent_body: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in one hour.
reset_password_body: Setting a new password signs you out everywhere, on every device.
reset_password_success_body: You've been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
missing_token_body: Open the link from your email again, or ask for a new one.
verify_email_success_body: Your address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify_email_failed_body: The link may have expired or already been used. Ask for a new one below.
resend_verification_sent: If that address needs verifying, a new link is on its way.
verification_required_body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Planning stays locked until the address is confirmed.
verification_required_hint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder, or send it again.
provider_link_required_title: This email already has an account
provider_link_required_body: Sign in to your existing account first, then connect {provider} from Settings.
provider_linked_notice: {provider} is now connected to your account.
provider_linked_query_notice: Your GitHub account is now connected.
validation_login_required: Enter your email address or username.
validation_username_pattern: Use letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen only — no @ sign.
settings_subtitle: Your account, sign-in methods, and appearance.
connected_accounts_body: You can sign in with any connected method. At least one must remain.
provider_disconnect_confirm_body: You'll be signed out on every device and will need to sign in again.
provider_disconnected_notice: {provider} was disconnected. Sign in again to continue.
change_password_body: Changing your password signs you out everywhere, including here.
change_password_success: Password changed. Sign in again with your new password.
sign_out_everywhere_body: Ends every session on every device, including this one.
danger_zone_body: Your trips stop being reachable and your personal details are erased. This cannot be undone.
delete_account_confirm_body: Type your email address to confirm. This erases your personal details and cannot be undone.
delete_account_confirm_mismatch: That doesn't match the email on your account.
account_deleted_body: Your personal details have been erased and every session has ended.
session_expired_body: Sign in again to continue where you left off.
